name: Obsidian Fortress
description: Obsidian Fortress is an imposing construction, built entirely from the cooled and shaped volcanic glass. Its reflective walls glow with fiery colors from the nearby molten flow. Nearby, numerous small ember islands float in the river, resisting its current as if the fortress magically attracts them. The fortress served as a place to imbue weapons and magic items with animal spirits, but this practice was forbidden by the last Red Mother and the place was abandoned. However, now that she is dead, some Mage Tower members have much interest in capturing the spirits in the Astral Plane, and then binding them in the Fortress, as powerful items could be produced from it. The place is dangerous, as the heat, steam vents, and lava explosions are common. Furthermore, legends speak of an undead shaman guardian patrolling the fortress
